data.key: Exalted Boon ~ Alseta ~ Turning of the Seasons
data.name: Turning of the Seasons
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day, you can use teleport as a spell-like ability. When you use this ability, increase your familiarity of your intended destination by one step. Using this ability cannot result in a mishap; if you roll a mishap on the spell's table when determining how well the teleportation works, treat it as a result of a "similar area."
